title: Add support for “External Document No.” in Subscription Contracts Fixes #8818
summary: Subscription Contracts now support an External Document No. field that is automatically transferred to generated sales documents and posted invoices, improving support for EAN invoicing scenarios.
key_points: Added External Document No. field to Subscription Contracts
Field value is automatically propagated to sales invoices during billing document creation
Propagation continues through to posted sales invoices
New test validates the end-to-end transfer of the field value
Low-risk change that only extends functionality when the field is populated
